description: Benchmarking tool to measure Stratum V2 and Stratum (V1) protocol performances in different contexts

links.title: Download Logs
links.tooltip: Download logs for the selected time range

panels.title: SV1 vs SV2 - block templates value
panels.description: Block template value in satoshis for SV1 and SV2 protocols. Higher values indicate more valuable block templates.

panels.title: Average latency with major pools (RTT)
panels.description: Round-trip time (RTT) latency measurements to major Bitcoin mining pools. Lower values indicate better network connectivity.

targets.legendFormat: SV1 - time to get a new job from Pool
SV2 - time to get a new job from JDC

panels.title: SV1 vs SV2 - time to get a new job from Pool/JDC
panels.description: Time taken to receive a new mining job from the pool (SV1) or job distribution coordinator (SV2). Measured in milliseconds.

targets.legendFormat: SV1 - time to get a new job (after a new block found) from Pool
SV2 - time to get a new job (after a new block found) from JDC

panels.title: SV1 vs SV2 - time to get a new job (after a new block found) from Pool/JDC
panels.description: Time taken to receive a new job after a block is found on the network. This measures how quickly the system adapts to new blocks. Measured in milliseconds.

panels.title: SV1 vs SV2 - block propagation time
panels.description: Time elapsed from when a share is produced until the corresponding valid block is broadcasted by the Bitcoin node. Measured in milliseconds.

targets.legendFormat: SV2 (jdc to pool + jdc to jds) (bandwidth)
SV2 (jdc to pool + jdc to jds) (total bytes)

panels.title: SV1 vs SV2 - Network Tx (miner-side)
panels.description: Network transmission (outgoing) bandwidth and total bytes transmitted from the miner side for SV1 and SV2 protocols. Bandwidth (rate) is shown on the left Y-axis, total bytes on the right Y-axis.

targets.legendFormat: SV2 (pool to jdc + jds to jdc) (bandwidth)
SV2 (pool to jdc + jds to jdc) (total bytes)

panels.title: SV1 vs SV2 - Network Rx (miner-side)
panels.description: Network reception (incoming) bandwidth and total bytes received on the miner side for SV1 and SV2 protocols. Bandwidth (rate) is shown on the left Y-axis, total bytes on the right Y-axis.

targets.legendFormat: SV2 (pool to jdc + jds to jdc) (bandwidth)
SV2 (pool to jdc + jds to jdc) (total bytes)

panels.title: SV1 vs SV2 - Network Tx (pool-side)
panels.description: Network transmission (outgoing) bandwidth and total bytes transmitted from the pool side for SV1 and SV2 protocols. Bandwidth (rate) is shown on the left Y-axis, total bytes on the right Y-axis.

targets.legendFormat: SV2 (jdc to pool + jdc to jds) (bandwidth)
SV2 (jdc to pool + jdc to jds) (total bytes)

panels.title: SV1 vs SV2 - Network Rx (pool-side)
panels.description: Network reception (incoming) bandwidth and total bytes received on the pool side for SV1 and SV2 protocols. Bandwidth (rate) is shown on the left Y-axis, total bytes on the right Y-axis.

panels.title: Pool apps (SV1) - CPU Usage
panels.description: CPU usage percentage for all SV1 pool-related applications and services.

panels.title: Pool apps (SV1) - Memory Usage
panels.description: Memory usage in bytes for all SV1 pool-related applications and services.

panels.title: Pool apps (SV2) - CPU Usage
panels.description: CPU usage percentage for all SV2 pool-related applications and services.

panels.title: Pool apps (SV2) - Memory Usage
panels.description: Memory usage in bytes for all SV2 pool-related applications and services.

panels.title: Miner apps (SV2) - CPU Usage
panels.description: CPU usage percentage for SV2 miner-side applications and services.

panels.title: Miner apps (SV2) - Memory Usage
panels.description: Memory usage in bytes for SV2 miner-side applications and services.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: System uptime showing how long the host system has been running continuously.

panels.title: CPU Cores
panels.description: Number of CPU cores available on the host system.

panels.title: CPU usage
panels.description: Overall CPU usage percentage for the host system.

panels.title: Host Memory
panels.description: Total memory capacity of the host system.

panels.title: Memory usage
panels.description: Current memory usage on the host system.

panels.title: Filesystem usage
panels.description: Disk space usage for mounted filesystems on the host system.

panels.title: Node Mermory
panels.description: Memory usage for Bitcoin node processes. Note: 'Mermory' is a typo in the original panel title.

panels.title: SV1 vs SV2 - shares
panels.description: Submitted shares and acceptance rate for both SV1 and SV2 protocols. Submitted shares are shown on the right Y-axis, acceptance rate on the left Y-axis.

panels.title: SV1 vs SV2 - mined blocks
panels.description: Number of blocks successfully mined by SV1 and SV2 protocols over time.
